name: hand-drawn-collage
title_zh: 照片变手撕纸拼贴画，原图配色一件不丢
tagline_zh: 别家转插画总把衣服、杯子、树叶的颜色改得妈不认。这版按原图逐块撕纸贴，A/B/C 三种版式，连长宽比都给你留着。
tagline_en: Other tools recolor your shirt, mug, leaves beyond recognition. This one tears paper per region, keeps original.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into a minimal hand-drawn paper-collage illustration in version A (original-plus-collage), B (pure collage), or C (full-page collage with poem). Preserve scene elements, clothing and object colors, and the source aspect ratio. Use when the user asks for photo-to-illustration, editorial paper collage, 原图对照, 纯手绘, or 整页撕纸拼贴. Generate with the host image model (image2).
why_zh: 不是风格迁移的“像”，而是按场景元素逐块重建：每块纸的颜色取自原图对应像素，撕纸边缘随机但构图可控。
why_en: Not style-transfer 'resemblance'—it rebuilds scene element by element, sampling each paper piece's color from the source pixels.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不吃多图合成或文字海报；输出是拼贴插画，不是高清写实图；A/B 版保留原图构图。
limit_en: Single photo input only; no multi-image or text-poster. Output is collage art, not photorealism. Version C crops edges to fill page. Requires host.
title_en: Photo to hand-drawn paper collage, colors kept
